url.title: XMLTV feed URL
url.description: The feed is downloaded once per refresh and shared by all calendars of this source.

data_description.url: HTTP or HTTPS address of the XMLTV file.
data_description.refresh_mode: Download the feed again at a fixed interval or once a day at a fixed time.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.description: How the times in the feed are read. Only needed when the feed's times are off.

data_description.naive_timezone: Time zone for feed times that carry no UTC offset: UTC (the XMLTV default) or the Home Assistant time zone.
data_description.offset_minutes: Minutes added to every programme time, from -720 to 720. Use it when a feed is off by a fixed amount.

file.title: Local XMLTV file
file.description: The file is read once per refresh and shared by all calendars of this source.

data_description.path: Absolute path of the XMLTV file (plain or gzip), for example /media/epg/guide.xml. Only directories Home Assistant allows can be read: the media folders and those listed under allowlist_external_dirs.
data_description.refresh_mode: Read the file again at a fixed interval or once a day at a fixed time.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.description: How the times in the feed are read. Only needed when the feed's times are off.

data_description.naive_timezone: Time zone for feed times that carry no UTC offset: UTC (the XMLTV default) or the Home Assistant time zone.
data_description.offset_minutes: Minutes added to every programme time, from -720 to 720. Use it when a feed is off by a fixed amount.

data_description.refresh_hours: How often the source is refreshed, in hours (1 to 168).
data_description.refresh_time: Time of day of the daily refresh, in the local Home Assistant time zone.

data_description.name: Shown as the title of this source in Home Assistant.

progress.download: Downloading the XMLTV feed. Large feeds can take a minute.

data_description.name: The calendar entity is named after it, for example calendar.formel_1.
data_description.channels: Channel IDs to include. Combined with the channel regex: a channel matching either is included. Leave both empty to include all channels.
data_description.channel_regex: Regular expressions matched against the channel ID, one per line, for example ^sky or \.de$. Combined with the picked channels (either one is enough). Leave both empty to include all channels.
data_description.include: Regular expressions, one per line. A programme is shown if any of them matches its title or sub-title (case-insensitive), for example formel\s*1|formula\s*1 or ^Tatort$. Leave empty to show every programme of the selected channels.
data_description.exclude: Regular expressions, one per line. A programme is hidden if any of them matches its title or sub-title (case-insensitive), for example Wiederholung. Blank lines are ignored.
data_description.advanced: Show a second form with the fields to search, case sensitivity, a time window, weekdays, a duration range and templates for event titles and descriptions.

data_description.include_fields: Fields the include patterns are matched against. Each sub-title and each category is tested on its own. Searching descriptions is slower on big feeds.
data_description.exclude_fields: Fields the exclude patterns are matched against. Each sub-title and each category is tested on its own. Searching descriptions is slower on big feeds.
data_description.case_sensitive: Match upper and lower case exactly. Umlauts match in any Unicode form either way; ß does not match ss.
data_description.time_from: Only programmes whose start time is between From and before To, in the Home Assistant time zone. A window crossing midnight, for example 22:00 to 02:00, counts for the day it starts. Set both or neither.
data_description.time_to: End of the start-time window (exclusive). Set both From and To, or leave both empty.
data_description.weekdays: Only programmes on these days. Leave empty for every day.
data_description.min_duration: In minutes, inclusive. Leave empty for no lower limit.
data_description.max_duration: In minutes, inclusive. Leave empty for no upper limit.
data_description.description_template: Placeholders: {description_fields}. Leave empty for the default description (sub-title, episode, categories, description).

preview.description:

preview_empty.title: Preview

error.invalid_regex: Invalid pattern {pattern}: {error}. Each line must be a valid regular expression of at most 300 characters, and at most 50 lines per field.
error.time_incomplete: Set both From and To, or leave both empty.
error.duration_order: The minimum duration must not be longer than the maximum.
error.unknown_placeholder: {template_error} is not an allowed placeholder. Allowed in titles: {title_fields}. Allowed in descriptions: {description_fields}.
